blogs.title: India could grow its fuel in the ocean
blogs.coverCaption: The ethanol in India's petrol doesn't have to come from a field. It can be brewed from seaweed — and Indian scientists already have.
blogs.author: Rohit Gupta
blogs.excerpt: The ethanol India blends into every litre of petrol is distilled from thirsty sugarcane and grain. But it doesn't have to be. The same fuel can be brewed from seaweed grown in the sea — no farmland, no freshwater — and Indian scientists have already pulled it off with a salt-tolerant yeast. Here's the idea that could change where our fuel comes from, and why it isn't at the pump yet.

blogs.title: Surveillance pricing: when the price tag is about you, not the product
blogs.coverCaption: Same shelf, same second, two shoppers — and two different prices, decided by what the shop thinks it knows about each of them.
blogs.author: The Sadapanna team
blogs.excerpt: More and more, the price you see online isn't the product's price — it's your price. Companies are using your data to guess the most you'll pay, then charging exactly that. Here's how it works, and how to make yourself a smaller target.

blogs.title: Meet InkFlow — turn any font into an animated write-on
blogs.coverCaption: InkFlow animates your text one stroke at a time — outline, fill, and true handwriting styles.
blogs.author: The Sadapanna team
blogs.excerpt: Type a word, pick a font, and watch it get written on-screen, letter by letter — then download it as a Lottie, video, or GIF and drop it into your project. Free, in-browser, and nothing you type ever leaves your device.
